item.text: [{"task_id":"7bb29440","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    bg = int(round(params['colors'][0]))","    first = int(round(params['colors'][1]))","    second = int(round(params['colors'][2]))","    steps = []","    for pair in params['neighbors']:","        steps.append((int(round(pair[0])), int(round(pair[1]))))","    height, width = grid.shape","    seen = set()","    best = None","    best_score = None","    for row in range(height):","        for col in range(width):","            if grid[row, col] == bg or (row, col) in seen:","                continue","            pending = [(row, col)]","            seen.add((row, col))","            cells = []","            while pending:","                r, c = pending.pop()","                cells.append((r, c))","                for dr, dc in steps:","                    nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc","                    if 0 <= nr < height and 0 <= nc < width:","                        if grid[nr, nc] != bg and (nr, nc) not in seen:","                            seen.add((nr, nc))","                            pending.append((nr, nc))","            top = min(r for r, c in cells)","            bottom = max(r for r, c in cells)","            left = min(c for r, c in cells)","            right = max(c for r, c in cells)","            patch = grid[top:bottom + 1, left:right + 1]","            score = params['weights'][0] * np.count_nonzero(patch == first) + params['weights'][1] * np.count_nonzero(patch == second)","            if best_score is None or score < best_score:","                best_score = score","                best = patch.copy()","    if best is None:","        return grid.copy()","    return best"],"shapes":{"colors":[3],"neighbors":[4,2],"weights":[2]},"params":{"colors":[0,4,6],"neighbors":[[-1,0],[1,0],[0,-1],[0,1]],"weights":[1,1]},"rationale":"Extract the nonbackground rectangle containing the fewest yellow and magenta cells combined.
